blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Prior case retrieval (PCR) aims to identify precedent cases relevant to a given query case. Existing PCR benchmarks and methods predominantly operate at the document level, treating entire judgments as the unit of relevance. This formulation is suboptimal for legal practitioners, as judgments address multiple legal issues and only a small subset of paragraphs is relevant to a particular query. Addressing this gap, we introduce UK-PRBench , a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval in UK case law, constructed from judgments obtained from the UK National Archives and covering a broad range of UK courts and tribunals. Furthermore, we evaluate state-of-the-art retrieval models and establish baseline results. Our experiments show that paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains challenging for current retrieval approaches, highlighting substantial room for improvement. UK-PRBench provides a standardised benchmark for evaluating fine-grained precedent retrieval and advancing retrieval systems for the UK legal domain.
blocks.zh: 先前的案件检索(PCR)旨在确定与特定查询案件有关的先例案例. 现有的PCR基准和方法主要在文件一级运作,将整个判决视为相关的单位。 这种提法对法律从业人员来说不够理想,因为判决涉及多个法律问题,只有一小部分段落与特定查询相关。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了联合王国-PR Bench,这是联合王国判例法中分款一级先例检索的基准,是根据联合王国国家档案馆的判决构建的,涵盖广泛的联合王国法院和法庭。 此外,我们评价最先进的检索模型,并确定基线结果。 我们的实验表明,对于目前的检索方法而言,段级先例检索仍然具有挑战性,这突出表明有很大的改进余地。 UK-PR Bench为评价完善的先例检索和推进联合王国法律领域的检索系统提供了标准基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Prior case retrieval (PCR) is the task of identifying relevant precedent cases for a given query case Shao et al. (2020) ; Feng et al. (2024) . It is a foundational application of legal natural language processing Leburu-Dingalo (2024) , supporting legal practitioners in citing related precedents to establish applicable law and construct arguments, as courts are generally bound to decide cases consistently with earlier rulings Joshi et al. (2023) . As the volume of case law grows, manually navigating available case law for relevant precedents becomes increasingly impractical Deng et al. (2024) , motivating the development of automated retrieval systems. Consequently, the development of automated PCR systems has attracted significant attention from both the legal informatics and information retrieval communities Hou et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 先前的案例检索(PCR)是确定特定查询案例Shao等人的相关先例案例(2020年);冯等人(2024年)的任务. 这是处理Leburu-Dingalo(2024年)的法律自然语言的基础性应用,支持法律从业人员援引相关先例来确立适用的法律和构思论据,因为法院一般有义务按照先前的裁决Joshi等人(2023年)裁定案件。 随着判例法数量的增加,为相关先例手动导航现有判例法变得越来越不切实际(2024年),促使开发自动检索系统。 因此,自动化PCR系统的发展引起了法律信息学界和信息检索界的极大关注(2025年)。

blocks.en: The development of PCR systems has been facilitated by benchmark datasets covering a range of jurisdictions and retrieval settings. Existing benchmarks include COLIEE Goebel et al. (2026) and IL-PCR Joshi et al. (2023) for English-language case law from Canada and India, and CAIL-SCM Su et al. (2025) and LeCaRD Ma et al. (2021) for Chinese case law. Machine learning (ML) approaches for PCR have also progressed from expert-knowledge and citation-network methods Saravanan et al. (2009) to domain-specific pre-trained language models such as Legal-BERT Chalkidis et al. (2020) , and more recently to dense embedding-based retrieval Joshi et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 涵盖一系列法域和检索设置的基准数据集促进了PCR系统的开发。 现有基准包括加拿大和印度的英语判例法的COLIEE Goebel等人(2026年)和IL-PCR Joshi等人(2023年),以及中国判例法的CAIL-SCM Su等人(2025年)和LeCARD Ma等人(2021年)。 PCR的机器学习(ML)方法也从专家知识和引用网络方法Saravanan等人(2009年),发展到Legal-BERT Chalkidis等人(2020年)等域前培训语言模型,以及最近发展到密集嵌入式检索Joshi等人(2023年)。

blocks.en: However, existing datasets and methods operate at the document level, treating an entire judgment as the unit of relevance Paul et al. (2025) . This formulation does not fully reflect the structure of judicial decisions. A judgment may address multiple legal issues, factual circumstances, and holdings Li et al. (2023b) , meaning that only a small number of paragraphs may be relevant to a particular query case, while much of the remaining judgment may be unrelated Nigam et al. (2022) . Document-level retrieval can therefore identify a relevant judgment while still requiring practitioners to locate the specific passages that support the legal issue under consideration. This can reduce retrieval precision and increase the amount of irrelevant material that must be examined Althammer et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 然而,现有数据集和方法在文件一级运作,将整个判断作为相关单位Paul等人(2025年)处理。 这一提法没有充分反映司法裁决的结构。 判决可能涉及多个法律问题,事实情况,以及持有的李等人(2023年b),意味着只有少数段落可能与特定查询案件相关,而其余判决大多可能与Nigam等人无关(2022年). 因此,文件级检索可以确定相关的判决,同时要求从业人员找到支持审议中的法律问题的具体段落。 这可以降低检索精度,增加必须检查的无关材料量Althammer等人(2022年).

blocks.en: Paragraph-level retrieval addresses this limitation by directly identifying the relevant portions of precedent cases, providing a more fine-grained formulation of PCR and a closer approximation of the information retrieval process involved in legal research Shao et al. (2020) . Despite its practical importance, paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains comparatively underexplored, particularly for UK case law. The absence of such a benchmark limits systematic evaluation of retrieval models in the UK legal domain.
blocks.zh: 段落级检索通过直接确定先例案例的相关部分,提供更精细的PCR配方,以及更接近于法律研究Shao等人(2020年)所涉及的信息检索过程,解决了这一局限性。 尽管它具有实际重要性,但段落一级的先例检索工作仍然相对未得到充分探讨,特别是对联合王国判例法而言。 没有这样一个基准限制了对联合王国法律领域检索模型的系统评价。

blocks.en: To address these gaps, we introduce UK-PRBench , a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval in UK case law. The benchmark is constructed from cases obtained from the UK National Archives and covers judgments from a broad range of UK courts and tribunals. Using UK-PRBench , we establish baseline results for state-of-the-art transformer and embedding-based retrieval models. Our results show that paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains challenging for current retrieval methods, highlighting the need for models and retrieval strategies specifically designed to identify relevant passages.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了UK-PR Bench,这是联合王国判例法中分款级先例检索的基准。 该基准是根据从联合王国国家档案馆获得的案件制定的,涵盖联合王国众多法院和法庭的判决。 使用UK-PR Bench,我们为最先进的变压器和嵌入式检索模型确定基线结果。 我们的结果显示,对于目前的检索方法来说,段级先例检索仍然具有挑战性,这突出表明需要专门为确定相关段落而设计的模型和检索战略。

blocks.en:
The main contributions of this paper are, ( i ) We introduce UK-PRBench 1 1 1 Available at https://github.com/DamithDR/uk-case-retrieval , a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval over UK case law, constructed from a large collection of judgments spanning multiple courts and tribunals. ( ii ) We evaluate a range of neural and embedding-based retrieval models,
establishing baseline results for paragraph-level legal information retrieval.

blocks.zh: 我们介绍联合王国-PR Bench 11 1,可查阅https://github.com/DamithDR/uk-case-retrieval,这是从涉及多个法院和法庭的大批判决中得出的联合王国判例法分款一级先例检索的基准。

We evaluate a range of neural and embedding-based retrieval models,

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Document-level Case Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.1 文件级案件检索

blocks.en: Case retrieval is primarily studied as a document-level task, in which the goal is to retrieve relevant precedents from a large pool of cases given a query case Feng et al. (2024) . Case retrieval is important across every legal system, and datasets have been constructed for a range of jurisdictions, including Chinese Ma et al. (2021) ; Li et al. (2023b) , Indian Joshi et al. (2023) ; Mandal et al. (2017) , German Wrzalik and Krechel (2021) , and United States Mahari et al. (2024) case law. More recently, Kim et al. (2025a) introduced LEGAR-BENCH, a large-scale Korean benchmark covering 411 crime types over 1.2M candidate cases, together with LegalSearchLM, a retrieval model that performs legal-element reasoning over the query and generates grounded content via constrained decoding.
blocks.zh: 案件检索主要作为文件一级的任务加以研究,目标是从一大批案件中检索有关的先例,以查询冯等人的案件(2024年)。 案件检索在每个法律制度中都很重要,为一系列法域建立了数据集,包括中国马等人(2021年);李等人(2023年b年),印度乔希等人(2023年);曼达尔等人(2017年);德国Wrzalik和Krechel(2021年),以及美国马哈里等人(2024年)的判例法。 最近,Kim等人(2025年a)介绍了LEGAR-BENCH,这是韩国的大规模基准,涵盖411种犯罪类型,超过1.2M类候选案件,以及LegalSearchLM, 检索模型对查询进行法律要素推理,通过受限制的解码生成有根据的内容。

blocks.en: A substantial line of work develops retrieval methods tailored to the legal domain. Pre-training objectives designed for legal case retrieval have been proposed Su et al. (2025) , including SAILER, a structure-aware pre-trained model that exploits the organisation of judgments Li et al. (2023a) . Others incorporate legal semantics more explicitly: Hu et al. (2022) combine topic distributions and legal-entity facts with BERT-based paragraph aggregation to better represent long case documents, while Dan et al. (2025) propose the Legal Event-Context Model (LECM), which integrates legal events with their surrounding context through an attention mechanism to improve accuracy and interpretability. To address data scarcity, Bui et al. (2024) use large language models to augment training data for case entailment and retrieval. More recently, Premasiri et al. (2025b) experimented with LLM-based encoders Ranasinghe et al. (2025) and showed that LLMs struggle with the task.
blocks.zh: 一项大量的工作是制定适合法律领域的检索方法。 为法律案件检索设计的训练前目标已经提出(2025年)Su等人,包括SAILER,这是利用Li等人(2023年a)的判决组织方式,在结构上经过培训的预培训模式。 另一些则更明确地纳入了法律语义: Hu等人(2022年)将专题分布和法律实体事实与基于BERT的段落汇总结合起来,以更好地代表冗长的案件文件,而Dan等人则将主题分布和法律实体事实合并. (2025年)提出法律事件-背景模型(LECM),通过关注机制将法律事件与周围环境结合起来,以提高准确性和可解释性. 为解决数据短缺问题,Bui等人。 (2024) 使用大型语言模型来增加培训数据,以便进行案件处理和检索。 最近,Premasiri等人(2025年b)试验了基于LLM的编码器Ranasinghe等人(2025年),并显示LLMS与任务有冲突.

blocks.en: 2.2 Paragraph-level Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.2 段级检索

blocks.en: A smaller body of work moves beyond document retrieval towards fine-grained, paragraph-level retrieval. Tang and Clematide (2021) build a Swiss (German) dataset of cases and statutes, extract case-to-statute citations, and estimate paragraph-level semantic similarity using a link-based method, showing that neural similarity modelling can be improved with an extended attention mask that suppresses input noise. On judgments from the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR), T.Y.S.S. et al. (2024) extract query-relevant paragraphs by aligning them with guideline themes and descriptions, and Upadhya and T.Y.S.S (2025) address cross-lingual paragraph retrieval. Query reformulation has also been explored, as in GuRE, a generative query rewriter for legal passage retrieval Kim et al. (2025b) . These efforts demonstrate the value of finer retrieval granularity, but they target other jurisdictions and settings. As a result, paragraph-level precedent retrieval for UK case law remains unaddressed, which is the gap this paper addresses.
blocks.zh: 规模较小的工作从文件检索转向精细的段落一级检索。 Tang and Clematide (2021) 构建瑞士(德语)案例和法规数据集,提取案例到法规引用,并使用基于链接的方法估算段落层次语义相似性,表明神经相似性建模可以通过一个可抑制输入噪声的扩展关注罩来改进. 欧洲人权法院的判决,T.Y.S.S.等人。 (2024)通过将相关段落与准则主题和说明保持一致来提取与查询相关的段落,Upadhya和T.Y.S.S.(2025)处理跨语言段落检索. 也探索过查询重写,如GURE中为合法通道检索Kim等人(2025b)的基因查询重写. 这些努力显示了更细微的检索颗粒性的价值,但针对其他法域和背景。 因此,联合王国案例法的分款一级先例检索仍未得到解决,这是本文件述及的空白。

blocks.en: 2.3 Legal NLP Resources in the UK
blocks.zh: 2.3 法律规定 联合王国的资源

blocks.en: As noted by recent studies such as Premasiri et al. (2025a) , there remains a considerable lack of publicly available datasets and benchmarks for legal NLP in the UK. Existing resources are largely limited to a small number of tasks, including judgment prediction Premasiri et al. (2026) and topic classification Chalkidis and Søgaard (2022) , while many other legal NLP tasks remain comparatively underexplored. This gap is also evident in widely used English legal NLP benchmarks such as LexGLUE Chalkidis et al. (2022) , which do not include any datasets representing the UK legal system. As a result, we believe that the dataset introduced in this paper will contribute to the growing legal NLP ecosystem in the UK.
blocks.zh: 正如Premasiri等人(2025年a)等近期研究所指出的,在联合王国,仍然相当缺乏可公开获取的合法NLP数据集和基准。 现有资源主要限于少量任务,包括判决预测Premasiri等人(2026年)和专题分类Chalkidis和Søgaard(2022年),而许多其他法律NLP任务仍然相对未得到充分探讨. 这一差距在广泛使用的英国法律NLP基准(如LexGLUE Chalkidis等人(2022年))中也很明显,这些基准不包括代表英国法律制度的任何数据集. 因此,我们认为,本文件中引入的数据集将有助于联合王国日益扩大的合法NLP生态系统。

blocks.en: 3 Constructing UK-PRBench
blocks.zh: 3 构建 UK-PR Bench

blocks.en: 3.1 Data source
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据来源

blocks.en: We construct UK-PRBench from UK judgments available through the UK National Archives Case Law service. 2 2 2 Available at https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk/ The service provides judgments from a wide range of UK courts and tribunals, including the Supreme Court, Court of Appeal, High Court, and various specialist courts and tribunals. Table 1 and Table 2 summarise the courts and tribunals represented in the source collection and their available coverage.
blocks.zh: 我们通过联合王国国家档案判例法服务,利用联合王国的判决建造了联合王国-PR Bench。 2 2 见https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk/。 该处提供来自联合王国各种法院和法庭,包括最高法院、上诉法院、高等法院以及各种专门法院和法庭的判决。 表1和表2概括了来源汇编中所代表的法院和法庭及其现有覆盖面。

blocks.en: We selected the National Archives as the primary data source because it provides case documents in machine-readable formats and covers a broad range of UK courts and tribunals. Although other legal repositories, such as BAILII, 3 3 3 Available at https://www.bailii.org/form/search_cases.html provide extensive collections of UK case law, their terms of access do not support the programmatic acquisition required for constructing our benchmark. We therefore obtained a transactional licence from the UK National Archives to access and use the case data for this research.
blocks.zh: 我们选择国家档案作为主要数据来源,因为它以机器可读格式提供案件文件,并涵盖广泛的联合王国法院和法庭。 虽然其他法律资料库,例如BAILII, 3 3 3 可查阅https://www.bailii.org/form/search_cases.html,提供了联合王国判例法的大量资料,但其查阅条件并不支持构建我们基准所需的方案采购。 因此,我们从联合王国国家档案馆获得交易许可证,以便查阅和利用案件数据进行这项研究。

blocks.en: The National Archives provides judgments in several formats, including XML, HTML, and plain text. We use the XML representation because it provides structured access to case metadata and judgment text. From each judgment, we extract its neutral citation, judgment date, and sequence of paragraphs. We additionally identify references to previously decided cases and the paragraphs cited within those cases. These citation relationships form the basis for constructing the paragraph-level retrieval instances in UK-PRBench .
blocks.zh: 国家档案馆提供几种形式的判决,包括XML,HTML,以及纯文本. 我们使用XML代表,因为它提供了对案件元数据和判决文本的结构化访问. 我们从每一项判决中提取其中立的引文、判决日期和段落顺序。 我们还查明了以前裁定的案件和这些案件中引用的段落。 这些引用关系构成了在UK-PR Bench构建段落级检索实例的基础。

blocks.en: 3.2 Citation Extraction and Instance Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 采掘和实例建筑

blocks.en: We identify case citations and cited paragraph numbers using a collection of regular-expression patterns designed to capture the citation formats occurring in UK judgments. For each identified citation, we determine whether the cited case is available in our collection and, where applicable, identify the specific paragraph or paragraphs referenced by the citation. Figure 1 illustrates an example of the citation information extracted from a judgment.
blocks.zh: 我们利用一套常规表达模式来识别案例引用和引用段落编号,以记录联合王国判决中出现的引用格式。 对于每一经查明的引用,我们确定我们所收集的引用案例是否可用,并在适用的情况下,确定引用引用的具体段落。 图1举例说明了从判决中提取的引用资料。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Example of case citations
blocks.zh: 图1:案例引用实例

blocks.en: To prevent models from exploiting explicit citation information rather than learning the semantic relationship between the query and precedent paragraphs, we replace extracted case citations with placeholders before constructing the retrieval inputs. The original citation information is retained separately in JSON format and is used to establish the corresponding query–precedent paragraph relationships.
blocks.zh: 为了防止模型利用明确的引用信息,而不是学习查询和先例段落之间的语义关系,我们在构建检索输入之前,先用占位符取代摘录的案例引用。 原始引用信息以JSON格式单独保留,用于建立相应的查询-前段落关系.

blocks.en: We subsequently remove citation instances for which the cited source case is unavailable in our collection. This is necessary because some citations refer to judgments that fall outside the temporal or institutional coverage of the National Archives collection. For example, the National Archives collection does not contain Supreme Court judgments from before 2009. We also exclude citations to European courts, including the European Court of Human Rights and the Court of Justice, because these judgments were not collected as part of our dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们随后删除了我们收藏中无法找到引用来源案例的例子。 这样做是必要的,因为有些引用指的是在国家档案馆收藏的时间或机构范围之外的判决。 例如,国家档案馆并不包含最高法院2009年以前的判决。 我们还排除援引欧洲法院,包括欧洲人权法院和法院,因为这些判决没有作为我们数据集的一部分收集。

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准建设

blocks.en: The resulting collection contains 64,284 64,284 judgments. From the citation relationships identified in these judgments, we construct paragraph-level retrieval instances consisting of an anchor paragraph, a relevant precedent paragraph, and candidate paragraphs. The anchor paragraph serves as the query, while the cited paragraph in the referenced case constitutes the positive retrieval target.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的汇编载有64 284项判决。 从这些判决中确定的引用关系来看,我们构建了由一个锁定段落、一个相关的先例段落和备选段落组成的段落级检索实例。 锁定段落充当查询,而引用案例引用的段落构成正检索目标。

blocks.en: We also include hard negative paragraphs drawn from the same precedent case. These negative examples are particularly important for paragraph-level retrieval because paragraphs within the same judgment may concern related legal issues while only one paragraph is explicitly cited by the query.
blocks.zh: 我们还包括从同一先例中提取的强烈否定的段落。 这些负面例子对段落一级的检索特别重要,因为同一判决中的段落可能涉及相关的法律问题,而查询中只明确引用了一段。

blocks.en: We construct two benchmark configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了两个基准配置.

blocks.en: • Single Paragraph Retrieval (SP): Uses the citing paragraph as the query and the cited paragraph as the positive target. • Contextual Paragraph Retrieval (CP): Extends the query and target with their immediate local context by incorporating the preceding and following paragraphs. This configuration evaluates whether contextual information improves retrieval when the relevant legal passage is not considered in isolation.
blocks.zh: • 单段检索(SP):使用引用段落作为查询,引用段落作为正目标。 • 背景段落检索(CP):将前几段和以下各段纳入,从而根据本地情况扩大查询和目标。 这种配置评价了当相关法律通道不单独考虑时,背景信息是否改善了检索.

blocks.en: Single Paragraph Retrieval (SP): Uses the citing paragraph as the query and the cited paragraph as the positive target.
blocks.zh: 单段检索(SP):使用引用段落作为查询,引用段落作为正目标.

blocks.en: Contextual Paragraph Retrieval (CP): Extends the query and target with their immediate local context by incorporating the preceding and following paragraphs. This configuration evaluates whether contextual information improves retrieval when the relevant legal passage is not considered in isolation.
blocks.zh: 背景段落检索(CP):通过纳入前段和以下段落,将查询和目标与本地情况直接联系起来。 这种配置评价了当相关法律通道不单独考虑时,背景信息是否改善了检索.

blocks.en: 3.4 Data Splits
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据分割

blocks.en: We divide the resulting instances into training, development, and test sets. The training set contains 15,363 anchor instances, the development set contains 2,128 instances, and the test set contains 4,403 instances. The candidate pool contains 8,739 paragraphs, including negative candidates designed to increase the difficulty of the retrieval task.
blocks.zh: 我们把由此产生的事例分为培训、发展和测试组。 培训集包含15 363个主机实例,开发集包含2 128个实例,测试集包含4 403个实例。 候选人才库包含8,739段,包括旨在增加检索任务难度的负面候选人.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We formulate paragraph-level precedent retrieval as a dense retrieval problem. Given a query paragraph from a citing judgment, the objective is to rank candidate paragraphs from precedent cases such that the paragraph explicitly cited by the query is retrieved as highly as possible. We represent queries and candidate paragraphs using text-embedding models and rank candidate paragraphs according to their embedding similarity.
blocks.zh: 我们制定段落级的先例检索是一个密集的检索问题。 鉴于引用判决中有一个查询段落,目的是将备选段落从先例中排序,以便尽可能高地检索查询中明确引用的段落。 我们使用文本组合模式代表询问和候选段落,并根据它们嵌入的相似性对候选段落进行排序。

blocks.en: 4.1 Embedding Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 嵌入模型

blocks.en: We select embedding models based on their performance in two established evaluation benchmarks, the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) Muennighoff et al. (2023) and the Massive Legal Embedding Benchmark (MLEB) Butler et al. (2025) . We use the rankings reported by these benchmarks to identify strong-performing embedding models for our experiments. This provides a comparison between models that perform strongly on general text embedding tasks and those that perform strongly on legal-domain embedding tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们根据两个既定评价基准,即大规模文字嵌入基准(MTEB)Muennighoff等人(2023)和大规模法律嵌入基准(MLEB)的业绩,选择嵌入模式。 Butler等 (2025) (中文(简体) ). 我们利用这些基准报告的排名,为我们的实验确定表现良好的嵌入模型。 这可以比较在一般文本嵌入任务上表现强劲的模型和在法律领域嵌入任务上表现强劲的模型。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Top-performing Models on MTEB
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 业绩最佳 MTEB模型

blocks.en: We select five of the top-performing embedding models reported in MTEB, bge-m3 Chen et al. (2024) , nomic-embed-text-v1.5 Nussbaum et al. (2024) , Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Zhang et al. (2025b) , Qwen3-Embedding-4B Zhang et al. (2025b) , and snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0 Yu et al. (2024) . These models represent strong general-purpose embedding systems according to the MTEB evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了MTEB、bge-m3 Chen等人(2024年)、Nussbaum等人(2024年)、Qune3-Embedding-0.6B等中报告的五种顶级嵌入模型。 张等人 (2025b) , Quen3-Embedding-4B. 张等 (2025b),以及雪花-北极-嵌入物-l-v2.0 余等 (2024). 根据MTEB评价,这些模型代表了强大的通用嵌入系统.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Top-performing Models on MLEB
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 业绩最佳 MLEB模型

blocks.en: To complement the general-purpose models, we select top-performing embedding models from the MLEB ranking Butler et al. (2025) . MLEB evaluates embedding models specifically on legal-domain tasks, allowing us to assess whether models that perform strongly on legal embedding benchmarks are better suited to paragraph-level precedent retrieval. Specifically, we used dinghy-law-4b-v1 Solka (2026) , jasper-token-compression-600M Zhang et al. (2025a) , and LGAI-Embedding-Preview Choi et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 为了补充通用模型,我们从MLEB排名Butler等人(2025)中选择了顶级的嵌入模型. MLEB评价具体嵌入法律领域任务的模型,使我们能够评估在法律嵌入基准方面表现强劲的模型是否更适合段落一级的先例检索。 具体来说,我们用dinghy-law-4b-v1 Solka (2026), jasper-token-compression-600M (英语). 张等人(2025a),以及LGAI-Embedding-Preview Choi等人(2025).

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate the selected embedding models under two experimental settings:
blocks.zh: 我们评价在两个实验环境下选定的嵌入模型:

blocks.en: • Zero-shot retrieval: In the zero-shot setting, the pretrained embedding models are used directly without any additional training on UK-PRBench . This setting measures how effectively existing embedding models transfer to paragraph-level legal precedent retrieval without task-specific adaptation. • Fine-tuned retrieval: In the fine-tuning setting, the embedding models described above are further trained on the training portion of UK-PRBench to adapt their representations to the precedent retrieval task. We use Sentence Transformers for fine-tuning. In addition to the embedding models described above, we include pretrained transformer models, namely bert-base-uncased Devlin et al. (2019) and legal-bert-base-uncased Chalkidis et al. (2020) , and fine-tune them for the retrieval task. This allows us to investigate whether task-specific fine-tuning enables smaller pretrained transformer models to perform competitively with dedicated embedding models. The fine-tuning objective encourages the query and its cited precedent paragraph to obtain similar representations while distinguishing the positive paragraph from hard negative paragraphs originating from the same precedent case. The same fine-tuning procedure and hyperparameter configuration which are shown in Table 4 are applied across all models to ensure a consistent comparison.
blocks.zh: • 支助 0 shot 检索 : 在零镜头设定中,预先训练的嵌入模型直接使用,没有在UK-PR Bench上进行任何额外的训练. 这一规定衡量了现有嵌入模型在不根据具体任务进行调整的情况下如何有效地转移到第一级法律先例检索。 • 支助 微调检索 : 在微调设置中,上述嵌入模型在UK-PR Bench的培训部分得到进一步培训,使其表述适应先例检索任务. 我们使用判罚变形器进行微调 除了上述嵌入型号外,我们还包括经过预先训练的变压器型号,即Bert-base-uncased Devlin等人(2019年)和Legal-bert-base-uncased Chalkidis等人(2020年),并对它们进行微调以完成回收任务. 这使得我们可以调查特定任务微调是否使经过预先训练的较小的变压器模型能够以专用嵌入模型进行竞争性运行. 微调的目标鼓励查询及其引用的先例段落获得类似的陈述,同时将正段落与来自同一先例案例的硬否定段落区分开来。 表4所示的同样的微调程序和超参数配置适用于所有模型,以确保一致的比较。

blocks.en: Zero-shot retrieval: In the zero-shot setting, the pretrained embedding models are used directly without any additional training on UK-PRBench . This setting measures how effectively existing embedding models transfer to paragraph-level legal precedent retrieval without task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 0 shot 检索 : 在零镜头设定中,预先训练的嵌入模型直接使用,没有在UK-PR Bench上进行任何额外的训练. 这一规定衡量了现有嵌入模型在不根据具体任务进行调整的情况下如何有效地转移到第一级法律先例检索。

blocks.en: Fine-tuned retrieval: In the fine-tuning setting, the embedding models described above are further trained on the training portion of UK-PRBench to adapt their representations to the precedent retrieval task. We use Sentence Transformers for fine-tuning. In addition to the embedding models described above, we include pretrained transformer models, namely bert-base-uncased Devlin et al. (2019) and legal-bert-base-uncased Chalkidis et al. (2020) , and fine-tune them for the retrieval task. This allows us to investigate whether task-specific fine-tuning enables smaller pretrained transformer models to perform competitively with dedicated embedding models.
blocks.zh: 微调检索 : 在微调设置中,上述嵌入模型在UK-PR Bench的培训部分得到进一步培训,使其表述适应先例检索任务. 我们使用判罚变形器进行微调 除了上述嵌入型号外,我们还包括经过预先训练的变压器型号,即Bert-base-uncased Devlin等人(2019年)和Legal-bert-base-uncased Chalkidis等人(2020年),并对它们进行微调以完成回收任务. 这使得我们可以调查特定任务微调是否使经过预先训练的较小的变压器模型能够以专用嵌入模型进行竞争性运行.

blocks.en: The fine-tuning objective encourages the query and its cited precedent paragraph to obtain similar representations while distinguishing the positive paragraph from hard negative paragraphs originating from the same precedent case. The same fine-tuning procedure and hyperparameter configuration which are shown in Table 4 are applied across all models to ensure a consistent comparison.
blocks.zh: 微调的目标鼓励查询及其引用的先例段落获得类似的陈述,同时将正段落与来自同一先例案例的硬否定段落区分开来。 表4所示的同样的微调程序和超参数配置适用于所有模型,以确保一致的比较。

blocks.en: 4.3 Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.3 检索

blocks.en: After model preparation, we encode all candidate paragraphs in the candidate pool into vector representations. For each query, we generate its embedding and compute cosine similarity against the candidate embeddings. We then rank candidates in descending order of similarity and return the top- k k candidates as the retrieval results.
blocks.zh: 在模型编制之后,我们将候选人库中所有候选段落编码为矢量表示。 对于每个查询,我们生成其嵌入和计算与候选嵌入的余弦相似性. 然后我们按相似程度的降序对候选人进行排序,然后将最高的KK候选人作为检索结果。

blocks.en: For the SP configuration, each query and candidate is represented by a single paragraph. For the CP configuration, the query and candidate are represented using their corresponding three-paragraph contexts. The maximum input length is set to 4,096 tokens to accommodate longer contextual inputs.
blocks.zh: 对于SP配置,每个查询和候选都用一个段落代表. 对于CP配置,查询和候选人使用相应的三段语境表示. 最大输入长度设定为4,096个令牌,以容纳较长的上下文输入.

blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates the overall retrieval pipeline, including model preparation, embedding generation, similarity computation, and candidate ranking.
blocks.zh: 图6显示整个检索程序,包括模型编制、嵌入生成、相似性计算和候选人排名。

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价

blocks.en: Following the previous research Joshi et al. (2023) , we evaluate retrieval performance using recall at different values of k k . We report results for k k ranging from 1 to 50, allowing us to assess both the ranking quality of the retrieved candidates and the ability of each model to retrieve the relevant precedent paragraph within increasingly larger result sets.
blocks.zh: 继之前的研究 Joshi 等人(2023年)之后,我们用 k k 的不同值来评价检索性能. 我们报告kk的结果从1到50不等,使我们能够评估被检索候选人的排名质量以及每个模式在日益扩大的结果组合中检索相关先例段落的能力。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Table 5 reports recall values for all models under the zero-shot and fine-tuned settings, on the single paragraph (SP) and contextual paragraph (CP) configurations. Even the best configuration retrieves the cited paragraph at rank 1 for only about half of queries, confirming that paragraph-level precedent retrieval is challenging on UK-PRBench . Below, we present the main findings.
blocks.zh: 表5报告回顾了在零镜头和微调设置下,在单一段落(SP)和上下文段落(CP)配置下的所有模型的数值。 即使最佳配置也只检索到第一级引用的段落, 下面我们介绍主要调查结果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Paragraph-level precedent retrieval performance across zero-shot and fine-tuned models and single-paragraph and contextual retrieval settings. Recall at k k (R@ k k ) are reported for k ∈ { 1 , 5 , 10 , 20 , 50 } k\in\{1,5,10,20,50\} .
blocks.zh: 表5:在零镜头和微调模型以及单段落和背景检索设置中,段落级先例检索性能。 在 k k (R@ k k ) 上, 报告 k { { 1, 5, 10, 20, 50} k\ in { 1, 5, 10, 20, 50}} 。

blocks.en: Legal-domain embedding models are among the strongest zero-shot retrievers.
blocks.zh: 法律领域嵌入模型属于最强的零射回弹.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Zero-shot R@1 as a function of model size for general-purpose (MTEB) and legal-domain (MLEB) embedding models. Results are shown for Single-Paragraph (SP) and Contextual Paragraph (CP) retrieval.
blocks.zh: 图7:零镜头R@1作为通用(MTEB)和法律领域(MLEB)嵌入模型模型模型大小的函数. 单段(SP)和上下文(CP)段检索结果。

blocks.en: Without task-specific fine-tuning, dinghy-law-4b-v1 achieves the strongest overall recall performance. It obtains the highest R@1 for CP retrieval (0.30) and matches Qwen3-Embedding-4B for SP retrieval (0.40). It also achieves the highest recall at R@5, R@10, R@20, and R@50 in both SP and CP retrieval, reaching R@50 values of 0.81 and 0.84, respectively. This indicates that legal-domain pretraining can provide a useful advantage for precedent retrieval. However, the advantage is not universal: Qwen3-Embedding-4B performs comparably in SP retrieval, while several other general-purpose models remain competitive.
blocks.zh: 没有针对具体任务的微调,dinghy-law-4b-v1就能实现最强的整体召回性能. 它为CP检索获得最高的R@1(0.30),并匹配Qwen3-Embedding-4B为SP检索(0.40). 在SP检索和CP检索中,R@5、R@10、R@20和R@50也实现了最高的召回,分别为0.81和0.84。 这表明,法律领域预先培训可以为先例检索提供有益优势。 然而,这一优势并不普遍:Qune3-Embedding-4B在SP检索中表现得相当,而其他几种通用模式仍然具有竞争力.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning produces highly model-dependent changes in retrieval performance.
blocks.zh: 微调产生高度依赖模型的检索性能变化.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Change in R@1 following task-specific fine-tuning. Positive values indicate improved retrieval, while negative values indicate degraded retrieval. Results are shown for Single-Paragraph (SP) and Contextual Paragraph (CP) retrieval.
blocks.zh: 图8:任务特定微调后R@1的变化. 正值表示检索改进,负值表示检索退化. 单段(SP)和上下文(CP)段检索结果。

blocks.en: The effect of task-specific fine-tuning varies substantially across embedding models. Figure 8 shows the change in R@1 following fine-tuning. For SP retrieval, nomic-embed-text-v1.5 shows the largest improvement, increasing from 0.29 to 0.54. In contrast, fine-tuning Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B substantially reduces performance, with R@1 falling from 0.36 to 0.03. A similarly strong degradation is observed for snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0 , whose SP R@1 decreases from 0.36 to 0.11.
blocks.zh: 具体任务微调的效果因嵌入模型而大不相同。 图8显示在微调后R@1的变化。 就SP检索而言,基因组合文本v1.5的改进最大,从0.29增加到0.54。 相比之下,微调的Qune3-Embedding-0.6B大幅降低了性能,R@1从0.36降至0.03. 在雪花-北极-嵌入-l-v2.0中也观察到类似的强烈降解,其SP R@1从0.36降至0.11.

blocks.en: The effect is similarly heterogeneous for CP retrieval. Qwen3-Embedding-4B improves substantially after fine-tuning, with R@1 increasing from 0.27 to 0.49. dinghy-law-4b-v1 also improves from 0.30 to 0.46, while jasper-token-compression-600M increases from 0.24 to 0.44. Conversely, snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0 falls from 0.24 to 0.00 at R@1. These results demonstrate that task-specific fine-tuning can substantially improve retrieval, but its effectiveness depends strongly on the underlying embedding model.
blocks.zh: 对于CP检索来说,这种效果也是多种多样的。 Qune3-Embedding-4B在微调后得到很大改善,R@1从0.27增加到0.49. dinghy-law-4b-v1也从0.30增加到0.46,而jasper-toppen-compression-600M也从0.24增加到0.44. 相反,雪花-北极-嵌入-l-v2.0在R@1时从0.24降至0. 这些结果表明,针对具体任务的微调可大大改进检索,但其有效性在很大程度上取决于基本的嵌入模型。

blocks.en: The benefit of contextualisation depends strongly on the retrieval model and training regime.
blocks.zh: 环境化的好处在很大程度上取决于检索模式和培训制度。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Relationship between Single-Paragraph (SP) and Contextual Paragraph (CP) retrieval performance measured by R@1. The dashed diagonal represents equal performance between the two settings. Points below the diagonal indicate lower R@1 with contextualisation, while points above the diagonal indicate improved R@1.
blocks.zh: 图9:用R@1测量的单段(SP)和上下文段(CP)检索性能之间的关系. 虚线对角表示两种设置的等效性能. 对角下方的点表示下R@1带有上下文化,对角上方的点表示改进的R@1.

blocks.en: The comparison between SP and CP retrieval shows that adding local paragraph context does not consistently improve retrieval performance. Figure 9 illustrates this variation using R@1. In the zero-shot setting, all models lie below the SP=CP diagonal, indicating lower R@1 when contextual information is added. For example, nomic-embed-text-v1.5 falls from 0.29 to 0.14, while bge-m3 decreases from 0.33 to 0.21. This suggests that, without task-specific adaptation, additional local context can make it more difficult to identify the cited paragraph at the top of the ranking.
blocks.zh: SP和CP检索的比较表明,添加本地段落上下文并不能持续改善检索性能. 图9用R@1说明这一差异。 在零镜头设定中,所有模型都位于SP=CP对角下方,在添加背景信息时表示下R@1. 例如,组装文本-v1.5从0.29降至0.14,bge-m3则从0.33降至0.21. 这表明,如果没有针对具体任务的调整,额外的本地背景就更难在排位前找到所引用的段落。

blocks.en: The pattern changes after fine-tuning. Several models achieve substantially higher R@1 with CP than with SP. Most notably, Qwen3-Embedding-4B increases from 0.31 to 0.49, while dinghy-law-4b-v1 increases from 0.36 to 0.46 and jasper-token-compression-600M from 0.37 to 0.44. However, contextualisation remains detrimental for some models, such as nomic-embed-text-v1.5 , which decreases from 0.54 to 0.28 after fine-tuning. These results indicate that the usefulness of local context depends on both the retrieval model and its task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 微调后模式变化. 一些模型的R@1与CP比SP要高得多。 最值得注意的是,Qune3-Embedding-4B从0.31增加到0.49,而dinghy-law-4b-v1则从0.36增加到0.46,jasper-token-compression-600M从0.37增加到0.44. 然而,背景化对于一些模型仍然有害,如经微调后从0.54降至0.28的组装文本-v1.5. 这些结果表明,本地环境的有用性取决于检索模式及其针对具体任务的适应。

blocks.en: At deeper retrieval depths, the same pattern is observed. For example, fine-tuned Qwen3-Embedding-4B achieves R@50 of 0.93 with CP compared with 0.77 with SP, while jasper-token-compression-600M reaches 0.92 with CP compared with 0.80 with SP. Thus, contextualisation can improve both early and deeper retrieval for some models, but the effect is not consistent across systems.
blocks.zh: 在更深的检索深度,观察到相同的模式. 例如,微调的Qune3-Embedding-4B在CP上实现0.93的R@50,而在SP上则达到0.77,而jasper-token-compression-600M则在CP上达到0.92,而在SP上达到0.80. 因此,背景化可以改善一些模型的早期和深度检索,但效果在系统之间并不一致.

blocks.en: Model scale alone is insufficient to predict paragraph-level retrieval performance.
blocks.zh: 单靠模型尺度不足以预测段落级的检索性能.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows that there is no consistent relationship between model size and zero-shot retrieval effectiveness. Among the Qwen models, increasing the size from 0.6B to 4B improves R@1 for both SP and CP. However, parameter count alone does not explain differences across model families. For example, the 0.137B nomic-embed-text-v1.5 reaches a fine-tuned SP R@1 of 0.54, substantially exceeding several larger models, while the 0.6B Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B falls to an R@1 of only 0.03 after fine-tuning. These results suggest that architecture, pretraining, and task-specific adaptation play an important role in retrieval effectiveness beyond parameter count alone.
blocks.zh: 图7显示模型大小与零镜头检索效果之间没有一致的关系. 在Quen模型中,将尺寸从0.6B增加到4B改进了SP和CP的R@1. 然而,单靠参数计算并不能解释模范家庭之间的差异。 例如,0.137B的组装-embed-text-v1.5达到微调SP@1的0.54,大大超过几个更大的型号,而0.6B的Quen3-Embedding-0.6B在微调后降为只有0.03的R@1. 这些结果表明,架构、培训前和针对具体任务的适应在超出参数计算范围的检索有效性方面发挥着重要作用。

blocks.en: Overall, paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains a difficult task, particularly at the top of the ranking. The strongest zero-shot systems achieve an R@1 of 0.40, while the best fine-tuned SP system, nomic-embed-text-v1.5 , reaches 0.54. At larger retrieval depths, performance is substantially higher, with the strongest fine-tuned models reaching R@50 values of 0.88 for SP and 0.93 for CP. The difference between R@1 and deeper recall demonstrates that many relevant paragraphs can be retrieved within the top 50 results but are not consistently ranked first. Improving the ranking of relevant paragraphs therefore remains an important challenge for paragraph-level precedent retrieval.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在段一级检索先例仍然是一个困难的任务,特别是在排名最高的国家。 最强的零射门系统达到R@1的0.40,而最优的微调SP系统,即Nomic-embed-text-v1.5,则达到0.54. 在较大的检索深度,性能要高得多,最强的微调模型达到SP的R@50值0.88,CP的0.93. R@1和较深的召回的区别表明,许多相关段落可以在前50个结果中检索,但并非始终排在首位。 因此,改进有关段落的排序仍然是在段落一级检索先例的一个重要挑战。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced UK-PRBench , a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval in UK case law. Constructed from 64,284 judgments obtained from the UK National Archives, the benchmark covers a broad range of UK courts and tribunals and includes both Single-Paragraph (SP) and Contextual Paragraph (CP) retrieval settings.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了UK-PR Bench,这是联合王国判例法中第一级先例检索的基准。 该基准以联合王国国家档案馆64 284项判决为基础,涵盖广泛的联合王国法院和法庭,包括单一段落和背景段落检索设置。

blocks.en: Our experiments show that paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains challenging for current embedding models aligning with the recent research Premasiri et al. (2023) . Legal-domain models perform strongly in the zero-shot setting, while fine-tuning can substantially improve performance, although its effectiveness varies across models. We also find that contextual information is not consistently beneficial, highlighting the importance of model architecture and task-specific adaptation. Overall, the relatively low R@1 scores demonstrate that accurately ranking the most relevant precedent paragraph remains an open challenge. We hope UK-PRBench provides a foundation for future research on fine-grained legal retrieval, including methods that better capture legal reasoning, contextual relevance, and citation relationships.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,对于目前与Premasiri等人(2023年)的研究相一致的嵌入模型来说,段级先例检索仍然具有挑战性。 法律领域模型在零镜头设定中表现强劲,而微调则可以大大提高性能,尽管其有效性因模型而异. 我们还发现,背景信息并非始终有益,突出了模型结构和针对具体任务的适应的重要性。 总的来说,R@1的分数相对较低表明,准确排列最相关的先例段落仍然是一项公开的挑战。 我们希望,联合王国-PR Bench为今后关于精细法律检索的研究奠定基础,包括更好地反映法律推理、关联性和引用关系的方法。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: UK-PRBench reflects explicit citation behaviour rather than complete legal relevance, as uncited paragraphs may also be relevant. Its coverage is also limited by the availability of judgments in the UK National Archives collection, with some courts, periods, and cited cases unavailable. Finally, our evaluation uses a fixed candidate pool and dense paragraph retrieval, which may not fully reflect open-ended legal search involving additional signals such as citation networks, metadata, and legal reasoning.
blocks.zh: UK-PR Bench反映了明确的引用行为,而不是完全的法律相关性,因为未经引用的段落也可能相关。 其覆盖面也因联合王国国家档案馆可提供的判决而受到限制,有些法院、期限和援引的案件不详。 最后,我们的评价使用一个固定的候选集合和密集的段落检索,这可能不能充分反映涉及引用网络、元数据和法律推理等额外信号的开放式法律搜索。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: We obtained a transactional licence from the UK National Archives to access the judgments used to construct UK-PRBench . We do not redistribute the underlying judgment texts; instead, we release the annotations and citation information. Researchers can obtain the appropriate transactional licence and use our citation extraction and instance-construction scripts to reconstruct the benchmark from the original judgments. This approach supports reproducibility while complying with the licensing conditions. As judicial records may contain sensitive information, researchers should handle the underlying documents in accordance with applicable legal, licensing, and institutional requirements.
blocks.zh: 我们从英国国家档案馆获得交易许可证, 我们不重新分配基本的判决书文本,而是发布说明和引用信息。 研究人员可以获得适当的交易许可证,并使用我们的引文提取和实例构建脚本,从最初的判决中重建基准。 这种办法支持可复制性,同时遵守许可条件。 由于司法记录可能包含敏感信息,研究人员应根据适用的法律、许可证和体制要求处理基本文件。
